'''RT441''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who was part of the security complement guarding the secret meeting between [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] [[Torpin]] and [[Vanko]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] when it was [[Attack on the Kuari Princess|attacked]] by the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]].
